g.text: Outcome-based one-liner — e.g. "Reduce billing-correction cycle from 14 to 5 days"
Describe the problem, not the solution. Include current pain · who is affected · what blocks today.
Why it matters · quantified outcome (revenue · cost · NPS · SLA · safety)

Class of Service defines swim-lanes, urgency policies, and WIP rules on the team boards.
Options: Small · Medium · Large · drives effort sizing & PDD threshold
Options: P1 Critical · P2 High · P3 Medium · P4 Low · P1/P2 drives Expedite class

— keep running operations; recurring/incidental work that protects current capability.
— net-new functionality, integrations, or products. Roadmap-driven.
— version upgrades · vendor refresh · regulatory-mandated changes.
Run / Grow / Transform — labeled at intake; default mix ~50 / 35 / 15 %
